checks.nuxtNextRoutingPages: Nuxt and Next routing: pages/, layouts/, plugins/, middleware/, server/, app.vue
checks.programEntryMainIndex: Program entry: main.*, index.* at a source root, cmd/, bin/, scripts/, benchmarks
checks.buildToolConfigurationConfig: Build and tool configuration (*.config.*, gradle, vite, nuxt)
checks.djangoConventionsUrlsApps: Django conventions: urls, apps, admin, settings, migrations, management commands, templatetags, signals
checks.phpFrontControllersConfig: PHP front controllers and config: public/index.php, bin/console, config/, Kernel
checks.goMainPackagesEvery: Go main packages (every file next to a main.go)

folderMap.cellProductionFileSized: A cell is a production file, sized by its lines and nested in the folders that hold it.

stackDiagram.breaksRuleInversionMutual: Breaks the rule: an inversion, a mutual pair or a cycle
stackDiagram.eachFloorUsesFloors: Each floor uses the floors below it. Line width is imports, on a square-root scale; the bar under a floor is its share of the files.
stackDiagram.besideLayersNote: Wiring and code that matched no lane stand beside the layers; their references are counted, not drawn.

folders.whereCodeLivesEvery: Where the code lives: every file by size in its folders, painted by role, health, churn or component.
folders.onlyFilesWhosePath: Only files whose path contains this (a folder or component path).
folders.whatColourShowsRole: What the colour shows: role (default), health, churn or component.
folders.snapshotRecordsNoFile: This snapshot records no file roles (it predates them), so the map is coloured by component instead; tests cannot be told apart here.
folders.snapshotHasNoFiles: This snapshot has no {colorBy} for files.
folders.linesFilesHealthBelow: {unhealthy} lines ({unhealthy2}%) are in files with health below 5.

stack.codebaseStackFloorsOrdered: The codebase as a stack of floors ordered so imports run downward, with the imports that point back up and the tangles the floors hide.
stack.onlyPartsAreaComponent: Only the parts of this area or component; the whole codebase when left out.
stack.nothingStackUnderHas: Nothing to stack under "{of}": it has {components}.
stack.topBottomOrderedSo: {floors}{value}, top to bottom, ordered so imports run downward ({grouping}).
stack.betweenFloorsPointBack: {links} between floors point back up, {importReferences} in all; largest first below.
stack.smallerUpwardLinksNot: {value} smaller upward links are not listed.
stack.noImportBetweenFloors: No import between floors points back up.
stack.importReferencesStayInside: {insideFloor} of {runtime} import references stay inside a floor; the stack does not draw them.
stack.tangleSitsInsideFloor: A tangle of {components} sits inside the floor {value}.
stack.soOrderBetweenFloors: So the order between floors does not mean the code is layered: the tangles above are not in the picture.
